# Web By Elie

Web By Elie helps independent businesses refresh existing websites, improve
search clarity, prepare site structure for AI-assisted search, review avoidable
web/tooling costs, and add practical ongoing website capabilities.

## Services (10 Business-Agnostic Modules)

### Core Pillars
- Website refresh (/services/refresh/): preserve useful existing website work,
  compare real visual options, and prepare a final site direction.
- Search Engine Optimization (/services/seo/): review titles, descriptions,
  headings, links, service wording, locations, and page structure.
- AI-ready structure (/services/ai-ready/): make basic business facts easier
  for people, search engines, and AI assistants to understand without guessing.
- Web spend cleanup (/services/cost-cleanup/): review unused subscriptions,
  overlapping tools, paid tiers, renewals, and account ownership gaps.

### Expanded Modules
- Ongoing site care (/services/site-care/): scheduled updates, backups, uptime
  checks, small content edits, and monthly plain-English change logs.
- Speed & accessibility cleanup (/services/speed-access/): mobile load
  speed, image/script payload reduction, keyboard navigation, and WCAG 2.2 AA
  contrast checks.
- Local & maps visibility (/services/local-presence/): align Google Business
  Profile, Apple Business Connect, Bing Places, and website hours/services.
- Platform move & ownership (/services/platform-move/): move sites cleanly from
  high-fee builders to fast static hosting while keeping URLs and ownership.
- Practical AI helpers (/services/ai-helpers/): small, guardrailed FAQ or
  inbox/intake helpers with clear cost caps and off switches.
- Multilingual sites (/services/multilingual/): clean localized pages (such as
  English, French, and Spanish) with proper hreflang signals and native wording.

## Case Study

- Golden Years Tax Strategy: a focused SEO/AIO and website-structure pass
  clarified audience positioning, search metadata, headings, prospective-client
  questions, and the consultation path. The site also moved from Squarespace to
  Cloudflare, creating a path to eliminate the Squarespace website subscription.
- The owner reported that prospective contacts began saying they found the
  practice through Google, which she said had not happened before.

## Important Notes

- SEO and AI-search work can improve clarity and technical readiness, but no
  ranking, traffic, lead, AI-answer placement, or savings is guaranteed.
- Most projects begin with a practical 10-hour initial bundle.
- Work is tracked at 100 USD per hour, with a check-in at 50% of the retainer.
- Contact: hello@web-by-elie.com
